pageTitle: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival/A Little Fox's Daydream
name: A Little Fox's Daydream
description: The usual path to the ramen stand presents multiple forms to you within the ever-changing dreamscape! The mushrooms standing in the little kitsune's path are all but swathed in ominous energies. Fortunately, our foxy protagonist does not usually take mushrooms in soup... Is the friend who our main lead intended to meet present at this ramen stand...?
